summary: Refuted by reading the loaders' source, not by running them. A jar whose archive comment contains an end-of-central-directory record is an empty archive to the JDK and the Spring Boot loaders as well, because they accept the same record as this reader; the answer lists what a loader can load. Documented limit, no code change. A JDK parity run stays optional confirmation. Carried to the push decision because the finding read HIGH and the refutation rests on source reading.
adjudicated_by: governance Gate 7 synthesis and the Architect's ruling; neither the change author nor the reporter (Gate 7 standard for rejected); the de-escalation rule's separation applies (a mandatory investigation resolved without a run)
adjudication_rationale: The reader accepts a candidate only when its comment length lands on the end of the buffer, which is the primary test of the JDK's own search; the answer is therefore the same record a loader would pick.
refuted_by: Public source read on 2026-11-15, not run (no JDK on the host): OpenJDK jdk-17-ga and jdk-21-ga java/util/zip/ZipFile.java Source.findEND scans the tail backwards and returns the first end signature where endpos + ENDHDR + comlen == ziplen; Spring Boot loader 2.7.18 CentralDirectoryEndRecord accepts the first signature with size == MINIMUM_SIZE + commentLength; 3.2.0 ZipEndOfCentralDirectoryRecord takes the last signature in the tail; zip_directory.hpp:133-137 applies the same rule as the JDK's primary test. Scope: those four tagged versions only.
refuted_by_reporter: the Architect for this run (read the loader sources); not the change author and not the reporter
